asset.name: beacon_courier_bot
asset.intent: Model and animate an original brass-and-iron courier bot that signals with the right arm while keeping both feet planted.

requirements.player_relative_scale: 2.75 blocks tall; ground contact at Y=0

parts.description: Square dark-iron face framed by brass; two amber eyes; short antenna.
Brass main body, square amber beacon insert and separate dark frame.
Independent arm with exposed round shoulder.
Independent signal arm; raised without moving the torso.
Straight metallic support with separate flat foot.
Second leg with intentional negative space between feet.
Rear dark vent and small metallic hinge detail.

articulation.notes: signal raises the right arm; torso and feet are world-stationary
idle produces subtle weight, not a limb translation
head sway is modest and returns to neutral

materials.style: 128px pixel atlas with intentional broad clusters and sparse edge highlights
dark painted metal; avoid noisy microtextures
pixel-art luminous appearance only; no unverified emissive/PBR requirement

animation_guidance.name: animation.beacon_courier.idle
animation_guidance.intent: small shoulder/head sway; feet planted; seamless loop

animation_guidance.name: animation.beacon_courier.signal
animation_guidance.intent: right arm rotates up about 65 degrees, brief hold, then returns; no foot sliding

constraints: Use Bedrock native Cuboids, minimum sufficient geometry and clear negative space between legs.
One 128x128 base-color atlas; UV Layout PASS before texture painting.
front_direction=-z; total visible bounds width 32, height 44, depth 24 Blockbench units.
No design changes after approval unless correction evidence identifies the wrong upstream owner.
No automatic PBR/particle/gameplay requirements; benchmark covers normal visual asset authoring.
User-approved voxel visual reference and package are READY for authoring intake; native Blockbench, final asset quality and benchmark acceptance remain UNVERIFIED.

non_blocking: Optional texture shading can be refined within approved palette.
